spec_references: Expressions > Literal: Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The whole negative case includes three base16 byte-array literals whose assignment compatibility must be checked. test_design_notes: The @error markers assert compile-time rejection; there are no @args, @panic or @output assertions.
